snippet.title: TRIANGLE STRATEGY | Xbox Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A tactical RPG from the team behind the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series.

Experience the dramatic story of war-torn Norzelia from different perspectives in stunning HD-2D, with a complex turn-based battle system. 

Now available on Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/game/9N0TCG0Z1NG4
